{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Final analysis: after deduplication and filtering
# Filter out -999 baseline
df_filtered = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df_filtered.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Compute response rates by arm
response_rates = df_dedup.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()

# Compute treatment - control
diff = response_rates['treatment'] - response_rates['control']

# Print key numbers
print(f"Number of patients after deduplication and filtering: {len(df_dedup)}")
print(f"Control response rate: {response_rates['control']:.4f}")
print(f"Treatment response rate: {response_rates['treatment']:.4f}")
print(f"Difference (treatment - control): {diff:.4f}")"}
